events.verdict: Nesmith (IND) initiates contact as he grabs and holds Robinson's (MIA) arm, while attempting to defend around the off-ball screen.
Nesmith (IND) goes to and through Adebayo (MIA), delivering illegal contact that dislodges Adebayo from his screening position.
Turner (IND) contests the driving shot attempt and marginal contact occurs to Robinson's (MIA) arm after the release.
Adebayo (MIA) momentairly brings both hands to Siakam's (IND) lower body, but does not extend them to deliver illegal contact as Siakam attempts to set the pick on the perimeter.
Adebayo (MIA) legally contests Siakam's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Herro (MIA) takes more than eight seconds to establish the ball in the frontcourt.

Replay review of the foul called on Nembhard (IND) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful and the call on the floor was overturned. There is clear and conclusive evidence that shows Nembhard makes incidental hand-on-ball contact that dislodges the ball away from Herro (MIA) during his upward shooting motion.
Mitchell (MIA) legally contests Haliburton's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) reaches in and marginal contact occurs to Herro's (MIA) arm, as he steps through the two defenders to begin his drive. Herro is able to move through the contact.
Nesmith (IND) reaches in and marginal brush contact occurs to Mitchell's (MIA) front.
Siakam (IND) extends his arm and delivers illegal contact to the front of Herro's (MIA) body, which affects his SQBR at the start of the drive.
Mitchell (MIA) legally contests Nesmith's (IND) jump shot attempt.
